rev6.release_notes: Updates: when an AI app's connection to CAD CAM (or a copy left behind by a closed session) holds it, the update says so and Update Both closes those connections and installs. A CAD CAM window is never closed.

cadcam.release_notes:
Sketch: dimensions sit outside what they measure, like a drawing, and numbers no longer stack on each other; laid out about twice as fast on big sketches.
Sketch: Fillet / Chamfer keeps one typed size for corner after corner. Trim cuts a line at the crossing, not the whole line.
Holes: the Quick hole tools start at 0.5000 in (10 mm in a metric part); a drill made for a hole is named by its decimal size. A hole's sketch points hide once the hole uses them and light up while the mouse is on one of its holes.
Quick Setup: the origin cubes are the right size from the first frame.
Recognize Part: the corner brackets follow the part through every turn; two threads on one drill size are never one pattern row.
Milling setups: pick the Z, X, Y and origin from the part (Advanced fold); a part set up with another side up is turned exactly, so its holes and 2D Adaptive come out the same as a picked frame.
2D Contour: the loops are cut in the same order every time. A picked wall that can't be seen from the setup's side says so in words.
AI connection: a part an AI opens while you work goes in a tab at the back; positions read in the part's units; a missed face names the nearest faces.
